# Hepsiba Devireddy — Portfolio overview

Hepsiba Devireddy is a Computer Science and Engineering student at SRKR Engineering College in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh. She is pursuing a B.Tech degree (2023–2027; CGPA 8.94/10) and is interested in full-stack web development, practical products, software problem-solving, AI-powered applications, and developing video-editing skills.

## Experience
Java Developer Intern, Infosys Springboard 6.0 (remote), Aug–Sep 2025. Resume-listed work includes authentication, RESTful APIs, and AI-powered PDF generation features in a collaborative full-stack project.

## Selected project: AI Learning Platform
The public repository README describes a full-stack study application with PDF uploads, document chat, AI-generated summaries, flashcards and quizzes, progress features, and collaborative study sessions. Listed technologies include React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Socket.IO, JWT, and Gemini integration. This summary reflects repository documentation and does not independently certify current production functionality.
Repository: https://github.com/DevireddyHepsiba/AI-learning-Platform
Demo: https://ai-learning-platform-silk-eight.vercel.app/

## Selected project: Store
The résumé describes a PERN commerce project with product management, authentication, payments, order tracking, and customer support features. Listed integrations include Clerk, Stream Chat & Video, Polar, ImageKit, and Sentry. These details are résumé-sourced; current demo and service availability can change.
Repository: https://github.com/DevireddyHepsiba/Store
Demo: https://store-beryl-five.vercel.app/
